verdict.rationale: LM Studio's app docs state almost word-for-word that it lets you "manage your local models, prompts, and configurations" (lm-studio-docs-6). Supporting evidence covers in-app model search and download (docs-4, docs-17) and per-load settings such as GPU offload, context length and identifiers via `lms load` (docs-13, docs-14). Community users praise the in-app download flow and the model eject button (comm-10, comm-19). Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of saved prompts and persisted per-model default configurations beyond a single line, and independent hands-on corroboration that prompts and configs are managed alongside models in one place.
